prompt: Redraw this boy as the hero of a whimsical hand-drawn sketchbook illustration. Same face: big curly hair on top, taper fade at the sides, 15 years old, friendly grin. He sits on a big office chair with a laptop on his knees, building a website. Around him a cosy cluttered desk scene drawn with the same loose pen: a large monitor showing a simple website wireframe (a big headline block, an image box and one button), sticky notes stuck to the monitor edge, a pigeon perched on top of the monitor, a mug of tea with curly steam, a stack of sketchbooks, a pot of pencils, a small rocket model, a trailing potted plant, a tangle of cable on the floor. Style: loose confident black fine-liner ink line art on pure white paper, charming and a little naive like a designer's sketchbook doodle, wobbly lines, a few small hatching marks, no grey shading, no colour, no fills, no text, no lettering. Wide composition, the scene sits in the right two thirds, the left third is empty white paper.
